name: Karim Byrd
life: “I still remember agreeing to a display in return for a better chair.” People around Tideline Market know Karim by a small Saturday habit. Karim picks out the bruised fruit first and asks the seller what will ripen by supper.
voice: I volunteered because I need new clients. I forgot my coworkers need the hours paid today.
appearance: Karim has a heart-shaped face and prominent ears. Look for short black hair swept back. After the last appointment, the familiar outfit is a rust-colored canvas coat with a pocket notebook shaped by years of sitting on it. In conversation Karim grins on one side while the eyes stay serious.
personality: Karim has a talent for getting adversaries to laugh at exactly the same thing. Karim knows better than to expect the laugh to settle what they are arguing about.
agenda: To gain new business without obliging coworkers to work free.
family: Tori Gran is Karim’s cousin. Karim chooses the music. Tori puts the kettle on. The cups come out before either brings up the reason for the visit. They trust a difficult conversation more if it has had an ordinary beginning. Asked about *Two portions*, Tori says, “Our shop donated tins nobody likes. I was embarrassed hearing what the cook did to make them edible.”
connections: Isla Joseph. A worker hoping to gain clients speaks directly with the person who booked the unpaid promotion.

reactions.situation: A promotional client insists on keeping the booking
reactions.response: Karim asks who will be paid to staff the booking before promising it can go ahead.

reactions.situation: A power cut leaves two neighbors waiting on the stairs
reactions.response: Karim asks which apartment is expecting someone home and makes sure that household knows about the delay.

reactions.situation: When people declare an argument over too soon
reactions.response: Karim asks them to describe one concrete thing that will be different tomorrow.
